notes: Fresh Sep 12 Toronto-morning B_V1 review of all 174 judge candidates. Every candidate was assessed for entity accuracy and all five B_V1 score components; hard rejects were applied for low scores, evergreen/prediction content, weak/noisy evidence and accidental ticker mappings. Typical entity failures included NEXT Weather→NEXT, Boeing KC-46→KC, immigration ICE→Intercontinental Exchange, electronic warfare EW→Edwards, AP news→Ampco-Pittsburgh, MongoDB→DB and Latham & Watkins→SWIM. Semantically duplicate inflation/Fed, Bitcoin ETF, ON Semiconductor and Paramount/WBD angles were collapsed. Ten distinct events cleared the conservative gate; fewer than 20 were retained rather than padding.
